source: The original generator's C source (the pret/pmd-red decompilation: dungeon_generation.c, dungeon_random.c, dungeon_map_access.c, unmodified), compiled natively and run on these seeds and settings, 2026-11-23. Each hash covers every tile's terrain, spawn flags and room, the start, the stairs, the Monster House room and the final random state. A further 3,600 floors were compared the same way and matched.
